description: Signalisation (stationnement sur rue) is a dataset listed in City of Montréal open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Ville de Montréal. Ensemble de données géolocalisant les panneaux de signalisation régulant le stationnement sur rue. Il est à noter que les panneaux de signalisation routière ainsi que d'autres fichiers supplémentaires qui fournissent plus de détails sur les codifications des panneaux sont disponibles dans un ensemble distinct. Coverage: Montréal. The portal files it under the publisher Ville de Montréal. Its tags are Arr., Panneau, PoleARTM, Rue, SUM. It offers 9 resource(s) in CSV, GEOJSON, JSON, PDF, ZIP. The portal shows 2026-09-30 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-montreal-portal.
